registeredBefore: any V2 model code exists in the repository and before any V2 run; this file is committed alone as the commit that follows d5d712edbbc578ab6f26ef73ee2975c84bdffa56
question: With a literature windage term added to HYCOM 15 m advection (surface-passive-advection.v2.windage), does the same 21-drifter cohort show smaller 24/48/72 h separation than V1, and does it now beat the stationary baseline (V1 criterion C1)?

windage.alphaPrimarySource: Lumpkin & Pazos, Measuring surface currents with SVP drifters (Cambridge, ch. 2): drogued SVP downwind slip 0.7 cm/s per 10 m/s wind (Niiler and Paduan, 1995) -> 7e-4

alphaSensitivitySources.0.0: V1 regression check (must reproduce V1 within 1 m)
alphaSensitivitySources.0.0086: same source, undrogued SVP 8.6 cm/s per 10 m/s
alphaSensitivitySources.0.01: Breivik & Allen 2008 undrogued SVP ~1% (via Sutherland et al. 2020)
alphaSensitivitySources.0.03: upper leeway range 1-3% for floating objects (Sutherland et al. 2020)

windage.rule: Only alphaPrimary enters the verdict. Sensitivity values are reported as a table and never used to pick a best alpha.

wind.provider: NOAA PSL NCEP-DOE Reanalysis 2 gaussian_grid uwnd.10m/vwnd.10m 2015
wind.timeAssumption: file time coordinate is the valid time of the 6-h forecast
wind.interpolation: bilinear in space, linear in time, no extrapolation; missing -> MISSING_FORCING

cohort.rule: No track added, removed or reweighted relative to V1.

metrics: paired difference V2 - V1 at 72 h
exclusionRules: identical to V1 comparator (drogue, QC, depth 15 m +-0.1, independence evidence, exact UTC match, ACTIVE/COMPLETED at horizon)
missingDataRules: wind or current missing at any RK4 sub-step -> particle MISSING_FORCING from that time; never zero-filled

acceptanceCriteria.C1_beatsStationary: pooled median separation at 72 h < stationary median at 72 h (alphaPrimary run)
acceptanceCriteria.C2_beatsPersistence: pooled median at 72 h < initial-velocity-persistence median at 72 h
acceptanceCriteria.C3_sampleFloor: >= 20 tracks with a compared 72 h horizon, >= 2 cohorts
acceptanceCriteria.C4_reporting: every excluded track / unavailable horizon listed with reason
acceptanceCriteria.C5_improvesOnV1: paired median of (V2 - V1) 72 h separation < 0 with at least 14 of 21 tracks improved
acceptanceCriteria.verdictRule: V2_ACCEPTED only if C1..C4 all hold (same rule as V1). V2_IMPROVES_V1 reported separately from C5. Thresholds are not to be changed after results are seen.

preregisteredExpectation: alphaPrimary 7e-4 with ~8 m/s winds adds ~0.5 km/day; expected |V2-V1| at 72 h < 2 km, so C1 is expected to still FAIL. If so, the conclusion is that the V1 failure in this quiet gyre is not explained by missing windage.
regressionChecks: alpha=0 run must match V1 final positions within 1 m for all 21 particles
V2 replay hash equals V2 run hash
V1 evidence files byte-identical after all V2 work (IMMUTABLE-V1.json hashes)
